scope: Human-curated, lawful, anonymous PDF routes for DOI-bearing nodes in publication_network.v3.json.

policy.inclusion: The URL returned PDF magic bytes without authentication and the linked source record or indexed PDF identified the expected publication.
policy.exclusion: Do not add paywalled URLs, authenticated sessions, ResearchGate-only routes, stale 403/404 candidates, search-cache-only copies, thesis-only reproductions, or URLs with expiring signatures.
policy.redistribution: Availability for local retrieval does not establish redistribution permission; downloaded files remain local-only unless their license is independently verified.
